hypotheses.reasoning: A template-svc-reconciler transaction held a row lock on notifications for 97+ seconds (#104). template-svc UPDATEs then hit statement timeouts (#111, #126) and lock wait timeouts in notif-db (#115, #117). That made template-svc /render hang, so notification-svc render calls timed out (#112). The template-svc connection pool then saturated, and the gateway returned 504s. Those last steps are symptoms of the lock, not separate causes.

verdict.recommendedAction: Kill DB transaction 99588 held by template-svc-reconciler to release the row lock. Then fix the reconciler to commit quickly and use shorter lock and statement timeouts. Watch the template-svc pool in notification-svc until it drains.
